name: Tandoori Oven (Logan, UT) Mild Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani) with Basmati Rice
whyItWorks: Logan's beloved Tandoori Oven! When ordered mild, Butter Chicken has a smooth strained sauce with zero seeds or chile heat. Turmeric provides anti-inflammatory curcumin, and basmati rice is ultra-low residue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Butter Chicken explicitly at 'Mild / Level 0' spice with steamed white basmati rice.
watchOuts: Contains dairy cream and butter; specify mild level 0 to avoid chili heat
